kitchen_rules: NEVER use native Claude Code tools (Read, Grep, Glob, Edit, Write, Bash, Agent, WebFetch, WebSearch, NotebookEdit) from the orchestrator. All work is delegated through run_skill.
The review-gate dispatch requires explicit human approval before proceeding.
Issues closed by the human during review are excluded by the BEM wrapper.
